values.summary: Authority-protocol review repairs are implemented, but the superseded v6 proof has been removed and exact current-source proof regeneration, full and shallow validation, and fresh independent review remain pending.
actual_changes: Bound production PrepareAuthority to the state-held verified route cut's exact polis id and membership epoch as well as its authority membership and boot generations, with real OpenRaft rejection of relabeled polis, epoch, and self-consistent wrong authority cuts.

Kept Guardian signer custody opaque, crate-private, runtime-local, and non-serialized; signatures bind guardian, certificate generation, boot generation, membership index, intent digest, committed prepare index, and finalization time, while actual finalize apply index is separately verified and recorded.
Made valid committed finalize return a fail-closed authority_publication_pending response with no token, artifact, projection, or authority-restoring read.

Removed caller-selected publication identity, root, and checkpoint authority from the public reconcile method; each store uses only its configured local voter context and proves fake-node, fake-root, fake-CAS, retry, and restart denial or reconciliation.
Retained direct protocol fault cases under cfg(test), kept production legacy command shapes fail-closed, and preserved exclusive voter-certificate not_after plus inclusive intent deadline boundaries.

Made the v6 validator independently enforce exact ordered canonical 47 case names, expected results, and marker hashes, with built-in substitution and reorder rejection in both full and shallow validation.

actual_validation.purpose: Regenerate exact current-source 47-case, OpenRaft, and strict Clippy proof.
Validate the independent exact-case contract in full and depth-one history after regeneration.
